messages:
Priya: Hey team — kicking off HelioThera onboarding. Theyre integrating Redwood for clinical note summarization. Main goals: reduce annotation latency, keep inference cost predictable, and get a smooth handoff to their platform team. Proposed kickoff Tue May 5 11:00am PT. Who can lead integrations, runbooks, and renewal playbook?

Miguel: Ill lead CS + success criteria. Quick note: their renewal is Sept 15 so we need a clear pilot-to-contract path. Recommend 4-week pilot + 2-week consolidation.

Omar: Ill own integrations. Need a small redacted dataset and expected traffic patterns (avg qps, burst qps). Also ask them to whitelist our IPs for S3 if theyre hosting samples.

Joanne: Success criteria draft:
- p95 inference latency <300ms on hosted trials
- Cost per 1k tokens within agreed budget band (well capture in dashboard)
- No more than 3 quality regressions on their clinical eval set during pilot
- Developer enablement: two workshops + API examples
- Ops: runbook and incident contact list delivered by handoff

Miguel: Timeline suggestion:
Week A (kickoff): access + service accounts + initial model pick
Week B: integration + smoke tests + basic perf
Week C: perf tuning, KV cache + batching config
Week D: pilot traffic, SLO monitoring, capture feedback
Week E: iterate + finalize runbook
Week F: success review + renewal recommendation

Omar: Quick ask for HelioThera: can they create a service account with read-only access to s3://heliothera-samples/prod-redacted by Friday? If no, well need a presigned batch. Also need their expected batch size and average sequence length.

Priya: Ill confirm with Dana (platform lead) and Estelle (CTO) for access. Also asking for their target cost per inference and if they need HIPAA-adjacent controls (theyre still in pilot but want to surface the ask).

Joanne: Ops checklist Ill produce: dashboard template (latency/cost/error-rate), template runbook sections, handoff checklist. Will post before kickoff.

Miguel: Action items:
- Priya: confirm access & attendance (Dana, Estelle, infra lead)
- Omar: upload integration checklist + sample curl + env var list
- Joanne: dashboard + runbook templates
- Miguel: define pilot success thresholds + renewal playbook

Omar: Sample curl / env snippet Ill include in checklist:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDCRED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"clinical-sum-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<note>"}]}'
```

onboarding-bot: Event created: "HelioThera Onboarding Kickoff" Tue May 5 11:00am PT — invites: Priya, Miguel, Omar, Joanne.

Priya: Any blockers?

Omar: Potential blocker: HelioTheras security team requires a data processing addendum before we can ingest redacted samples. If DPA takes >3 business days we should plan for presigned URLs instead.

Miguel: Noted — Ill loop Legal and add a Week 0 DPA checkpoint. Also tagging eng-sre for IP whitelisting guidance.

Joanne: Great. Ill draft the kickoff agenda and post here 24h before the meeting. Weekly cadence: Fridays 10:00am PT for status during pilot. :white_check_mark:
